transcripts.en-visit-1:
Arun: Thanks for making time, Priya. I wanted to walk through the revised quote for the cold-storage units.
Priya: Sure. Last time the main concern was the delivery schedule. Our new outlet in Coimbatore opens on the fifteenth of December.
Arun: Understood. With the twelve-unit option we can deliver in two batches, eight units in the last week of November and four in the first week of December.
Priya: That works if installation is included. Who handles installation on our side?
Arun: Our technician, Meena, will coordinate with your facilities team. I will send you her contact details today.
transcripts.en-visit-2:
Priya: Good. On pricing, finance asked whether the annual maintenance contract can be split into quarterly payments.
Arun: I think so, but I need to confirm with our accounts team. I will get back to you by Wednesday.
Priya: Also, can the units log temperatures to our existing dashboard? We use a cloud system from another vendor.
Arun: The units export CSV over USB today. A direct integration would be a separate project. Let us not include it in this order.
Priya: Agreed, keep it out of scope for now. We can revisit it in the new year.
transcripts.en-visit-3:
Ravi: Sorry I am late. Priya, did you raise the power backup question?
Priya: Not yet. Arun, our Coimbatore site has frequent power cuts. How long do the units hold temperature without power?
Arun: The spec sheet says six hours with the door closed, but that was measured in a lab. I would not promise that for a busy store.
Ravi: Then we need a generator connection. I will ask our electrician to check the site load before the first delivery.
Arun: Please share the electrician's findings with Meena so she can plan the wiring.
transcripts.en-visit-4:
Priya: Let me summarise. We go ahead with the twelve-unit option, delivered in two batches. Installation is included.
Arun: Yes. I will send the revised quote with the delivery dates by Friday, and Meena's contact details today.
Priya: I need to get purchase approval from our director, Suresh. He is travelling, so it may take a week.
Ravi: I will get the electrician's report before the first batch arrives.
Arun: One open point is the quarterly payment option. I will confirm that by Wednesday. Anything else?
Priya: No, that covers it. Thank you, Arun.

Neha: Rahul, कल वाली meeting में हमने delivery timeline discuss की थी, उसका update क्या है?
Rahul: Vendor ने confirm किया है कि पहला shipment अगले Monday तक आ जाएगा।
Neha: ठीक है। Invoice कौन भेजेगा?
Rahul: Invoice मैं भेज दूँगा, शुक्रवार तक।
Neha: और training session का क्या? Team को नई billing system सीखनी है।
Rahul: Training अगले महीने रखते हैं, date मैं बाद में बताऊँगा।
transcripts.ta-en-visit-1:
Karthik: Divya, நேத்து client meeting எப்படி போச்சு?
Divya: நல்லா போச்சு. அவங்க revised proposal கேட்டாங்க, pricing கொஞ்சம் குறைக்கணும்னு சொன்னாங்க.
Karthik: சரி, proposal யாரு அனுப்புவாங்க?
Divya: நான் அனுப்புறேன், வியாழக்கிழமைக்குள்ள.
Karthik: Demo-வ அடுத்த வாரம் வச்சுக்கலாமா?
Divya: சரி, Tuesday morning fix பண்ணலாம். நான் calendar invite அனுப்புறேன்.

Anoop: Sreeja, ഇന്നലത്തെ site visit എങ്ങനെ ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു?
Sreeja: നന്നായി. അവർക്ക് പുതിയ quotation വേണം, installation charges കുറയ്ക്കാൻ പറഞ്ഞു.
Anoop: Quotation ആരാണ് അയക്കുന്നത്?
Sreeja: ഞാൻ അയക്കാം, തിങ്കളാഴ്ചക്കുള്ളിൽ.
Anoop: Final decision എപ്പോഴാണ്?
Sreeja: അവരുടെ manager അടുത്ത ആഴ്ച തീരുമാനിക്കും എന്നാണ് പറഞ്ഞത്.
